posts.title: Connect AI to your live figures and it starts telling you what matters
posts.description: An AI you can only talk to is a conversation partner. It responds to what you say, and it knows only as much about your business as you paste into the chat. Give it direct access to your live business data (sales, customers signing up and leaving, the reach of your content) and its role changes. posts.title: How you delegate a task depends on how complex and urgent it is
posts.description: When a task lands on your desk and you’re the one with the most experience in it, the question isn’t whether to delegate but how. posts.title: A priority only counts if it pushes something else out
posts.description: Priority labels cost nothing, and anything that costs nothing gets spent recklessly. At first you mark three things P1.
